intro: Guatemala is a presidential republic fighting corruption.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for a single four-year term. Congress has one chamber of 160 members.

chapters.title: Justice
text: A UN-backed commission fought corruption from 2007 until it was closed in 2019.

keyTerms.meaning: Dishonest use of power for gain.
